description: Managing-user-flow skill — flow inventory operations, confirmation gates, and post-write verification

tests.description: [smoke] add — requires preview and explicit confirmation before any write

vars.user_prompt: Add a new user flow named UF-Billing-Alerts for billing alerts in migration-utility.
vars.simulated_context:
- The operation is clearly `add`.
- The cached sheet has exactly 13 columns and does not contain `UF-Billing-Alerts`.
- The cached Linear child labels under `User Flow` do not contain `UF-Billing-Alerts`.
- The user has not yet supplied the required repo, category, title, status, and persona fields.
- No confirmation has been given yet.

tests.description: drift — read-only sync check uses cached active rows and labels

vars.user_prompt: Check whether the flow inventory sheet and Linear labels are in sync.
vars.simulated_context:
- The operation is clearly `drift`.
- The cached sheet has exactly 13 columns.
- Active rows include `UF-Exports` and `UF-Approvals`.
- A row `UF-Legacy` is `retired` and a row `UF-Pilot` is `parked`.
- Cached Linear child labels include `UF-Exports` and `UF-Orphaned`.
- No write operation is requested.

tests.description: ambiguous request — asks one operation question before proceeding

vars.user_prompt: Can you update the user flow inventory for approvals?
vars.simulated_context:
- The request does not reveal whether the user wants add, retire, rename, merge, split, or drift.
- The cached sheet and label list were loaded successfully.
- No safe default operation can be inferred.

tests.description: merge — post-write verification uses updated cached state and keeps manual archive separate

vars.user_prompt: Merge UF-Export-Setup and UF-Export-Delivery into UF-Exports-End-To-End.
vars.simulated_context:
- The operation is clearly `merge`.
- The cached sheet has exactly 13 columns.
- Both source rows exist and are active.
- `UF-Exports-End-To-End` does not already exist in the cached sheet or label list.
- The new title is supplied.
- The user has confirmed repo, category, status, and persona values.
- The cached Linear issue union count is 17.
- The user has already responded `confirm` to the Change Preview.
- All sheet writes, label creation, and issue re-tags succeed.
- Manual label archive is still required because the MCP cannot archive labels.

tests.description: rename — exact schema guard blocks before writes on expanded sheet

vars.simulated_context:
- The operation is clearly `rename`.
- The cached CSV has 14 columns because the sheet owner inserted a new column.
- The matching source row exists and is active.
- The new ID is otherwise unique.
- The user would confirm if asked, but the schema issue is detected first.

tests.description: split — appended rows populate column M and never write column L

vars.user_prompt: Split UF-Approvals into UF-Approval-Requests and UF-Approval-Reviews.
vars.simulated_context:
- The operation is clearly `split`.
- The cached sheet has exactly 13 columns.
- The source row exists and is active.
- Both new IDs are unique in the cached sheet and label list.
- Titles and per-flow metadata are supplied.
- The open issues were reviewed, assignments were adjusted, and the user already responded `confirm` to both the recommendation table and the Change Preview.
- All writes succeed.

tests.description: retire — warns about open issues and keeps label archive manual

vars.simulated_context:
- The operation is clearly `retire`.
- The cached sheet has exactly 13 columns.
- The matching row exists and is not yet retired.
- The cached label list includes `UF-Exports-Legacy` under `User Flow`.
- The open issue query returns three started issues.
- The user has not yet acknowledged the open-issue warning or the Change Preview.
